description.narrative: Increased agricultural productivity in the project area

Grain yields increased by 27% from 5.74 tons/ha in 2010 to 7.31 tons/ha by 2018, cash crop yields (excluding vegetables) by 27% from 1.90 tons/ha in 2010 to 2.41 tons/ha by 2017, and vegetables by 27% from 25.2 tons/ha in 2010 to 32.0 tons/ha by 2018 Progress/Status: Implementation of the project has started in April 2013. Procurement for works and goods for some provinces have started in Q4 of 2013. Data Source: County, provincial, and national economic records and annual statistics
Water resource bureaus' statistics
Project performance monitoring and progress reports by the PMO
Project completion and evaluation reports

Overall irrigation water use efficiency increased from 40% in 2010 to 45% by 2017 for surface water irigation systems, and from 60% in 2010 to 75% by 2017 for groundwater irrigation systems Progress/Status: Implementation of the project has started in April 2013. Procurement for works and goods for some provinces have started in Q4 of 2013.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: About 50% or more of employment opportunities created under the project taken up by women by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, about 50.01% or more of employment opportunities created under the project taken up by women

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: About 68 WUAs formed or strengthened by 2018, with at least 35% female participation as WUA members and as WUA committee members Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, about 29 WUAs formed or strengthened, with at least 40.96% female participation as WUA members and 28.5% as WUA committee members Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: Drainage of about 117,000 ha land improved by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, Drainage of about 110,297.11 ha land improved. Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: Groundwater irrigation systems developed or improved in 41,183 ha by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, groundwater irrigation systems developed or improved in 33,348.43 ha. Data Source: County and provincial annual statistcs

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: Surface water irrigation upgraded and/or completed in 56,588 ha by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, improved surface water irrigation upgraded and/or completed in 65,500.36 ha. Data Source: County and provincial water resource bureaus' records

Output: 1. Improved irrigation and drainage infrastructure Indicator: Water-saving technology introduced in 74,495 ha by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, water-saving technology introduced in 64,604.83 ha. Data Source: WUAs' monitoring and evaluation reports

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: 1,866 km of farm access roads improved by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, 1,957.94 km farm access roads improved. Data Source: County and provincial annual statistics

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: 50% or more of employment opportunities created under the project taken up by women by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, there are 52.23% of employment opportunities created under the project taken up by women

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: Establishment and strengthening of 117 FPAs, with at least 35% female participation as FPA members and as FPA management committee members Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, establishment and strengthening of 64 FPAs, with at least 38.86% female participation as FPA members and 28.5% as FPA management committee members Data Source: ADB review missions

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: Farmers' farming skills improved by provision of 16,904 person-months of training, with at least 50% female participation, by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, farmers' farming skills improved by provision of 5,450.52 person-months of training, with at least 52.23% female participation.

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: Improved mechanized farming from 74% of farmers in 2010 to over 80% by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, improved mechanized farming from 86.44% of farmers Data Source: FPAs' records and reports

Output: 2. Improved agricultural support Indicator: Soil improvement implemented i 67,138 ha by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, soil improvement implemented in 42,602.14 ha Data Source: Project progress reports

Output: 3. Improved project management Indicator: Implementation and management capacity of the executing and implementing agencies improved through training by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, the project has organized farmers training of 4,736.52 person-months and project management staff training of 543.81 person-months. Data Source: Project progress reports
Training evaluation records

Output: 3. Improved project management Indicator: Integrated management information system for the project established and operational by 2018 Progress/Status: As of 30 June 2018, the project has provided domestic and international trainings to 2,969 project management staff using 562.74 person months of trainer inputs. The POCADs have procured 1,600 sets of office devices and 424 sets of servers for the agricultural information systems Data Source: ADB review missions
